errorCodes.meaning: The signer is not an active member of this community.
`fields` names a field the schema does not have.
`fields` names a field that is not `credential`-sourced.
The presentation does not verify, is not bound to this document and this community, or its holder is not the signer.
The credential's issuer is not one the field accepts.
The presentation does not disclose the claim a named field reads.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

FieldKey.description: Identifier of a directory field. A key with no `.` is a BASE field, the same in every community: `displayName`, `nickname`, `avatar`, `pronouns`, `bio`, `links` (written by the member) and `role`, `joinedAt`, `did`, `personhood` (derived from the community's own records, never stored on a card). A community-defined field MUST use a reverse-DNS key (`org.example.employer`), so a base key never collides with one, and a key is never reused with a different meaning once defined.
FieldKey.title: FieldKey

Response.description: The success response to a vtc/directory/card/present/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/directory/card/present/0.1#response.

verified.description: The values now on the card, keyed by field.

Response.title: VTC Directory — Card — Present — response payload

VerifiedValue.description: The value of a `credential`-sourced field: a claim the member disclosed from a credential they presented, with the issuer that attests it. A verified value always names its issuer, and a self-asserted value is never shaped as one. The community keeps only the disclosed claim and these facts about it — never the presentation.

credentialType.description: The most specific `type` of the credential the claim came from.

issuer.description: DID of the credential's issuer, shown as the field's verification badge.

validUntil.description: When the credential expires, where it does. The community withdraws the value once it passes.

verifiedAt.description: When the community verified the presentation.

VerifiedValue.title: VerifiedValue

schema.description: A member presents a credential so the community can fill credential-sourced directory fields with the disclosed claims, badged with their issuer; the community keeps the claims, never the presentation. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

clear.description: Optional: also clear any named field the presentation does not answer. Absent: false.

anyOf.description: A W3C Verifiable Presentation whose `nonce` is this document's `id` and whose `domain` is the community's DID, both signed by its holder's Data Integrity proof.
A compact presentation (an SD-JWT with a key-binding JWT whose `nonce` is this document's `id` and `aud` the community's DID).
